topic: Checking In for a Doctor Visit

script.title: AT THE CLINIC DESK
script.story_hook: A new patient faces his first clinic check-in.
script.intro_zh: 一位新病人，第一次在診所櫃台報到。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we check in at a doctor's office. Listen for polite desk phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到診所櫃台報到。留意有禮貌的應對說法。
script.outro: Forms done, blood pressure logged, patient delivered. See you next time!
script.outro_zh: 表填好了，血壓記好了，病人也送到了。下次再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each check-in phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀報到常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a retired man in his sixties with short gray hair and a neat gray mustache, wearing a navy zip-up sweater, khaki slacks and brown loafers, slightly stooped, average build, warm smile
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her thirties with dark brown hair in a low bun, wearing light blue scrubs, white sneakers and a smartwatch, average build, friendly and brisk

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm new here. I need to check in.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm nu hɪɹ aɪ nid tə tʃɛk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 你好，我頭回來這裡報到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure thing. Do you have an appointment?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃʊɹ θɪŋ du ju hæv æn əˈpɑɪntmənt/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，你有預約嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, at nine-fifteen. Frank Miller.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs æt naɪn ˈfɪfˈtin fræŋk ˈmɪlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 九點十五，我叫法蘭克．米勒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Can I see your insurance card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt kaɪ si jʊɹ ɪnˈʃʊɚəns kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，保險卡給我看看好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here you go. Um, is this one okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɡoʊ ʌm ɪz ðɪs wʌn oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 給你。呃，這張可以用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, this plan ended last May.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðɪs plæn ˈɛndəd læst meɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這個保險去年五月就到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my new card just came this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ maɪ nju kɑɹd dʒʌst keɪm ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 糟了，我的新卡這週才到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Do you have the new number?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm du ju hæv ðə nju ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，新保險號碼手上有嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check my phone. Ah, here's a photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk maɪ foʊn ɑ hɪɹz ə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我拿手機看看。啊，這裡有照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that works for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt ðæt wɜɹks fɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，今天這樣就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. What else do you need from me?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju wʌt ɛls du ju nid fɚm mi/
dialogue.zh: 呼，還需要我什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your date of birth, and phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ deɪt əv bɚθ ænd foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 出生日期和電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: March third, nineteen fifty-eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɑɹθ θɜɹd ˌnaɪnˈtin ˈfɪfti‿eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 三月三日，一九五八年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Any allergies we should know?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈɛniˌældʒi z wi ˈʃʊd noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。有什麼過敏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just penicillin. It gives me a rash.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˌpɛnəˈsɪlɪn ɪt ɡɪvz mi ə ɹæʃ/
dialogue.zh: 只有青黴素，會讓身體起疹子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. So, what brings you in today?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ soʊ wʌt bɹɪŋz ju ɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好的，今天你是哪裡不舒服？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My blood pressure. I get dizzy sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ blʌd ˈpɹɛʃɚ aɪ ɡɛt ˈdɪzi ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 我的血壓，偶爾會頭暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long has that been going on?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæz ðæt bɪn ˈɡoʊɪŋ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 這種情形多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About two weeks, mostly in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt tu wɪks ˈmoʊstli ɪn ðə ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 大約兩週，多半在早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll write that down. Any chest pain?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɹaɪt ðæt daʊn ˈɛni tʃɛst peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我寫下來。胸口會痛嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, never. Just the dizziness.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈnɛvɚ dʒʌst ðə ˈdɪzɪnəs/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，從來不痛，只是頭暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Please fill out these new-patient forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pliz fɪl aʊt ðiz nju ˈpeɪʃənt fɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 好，請填寫這幾張新病人表格。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pages is that? Four?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛnɪ ˈpeɪdʒɪz ɪz ðæt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 總共幾頁啊？四頁？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two for you. Here's a pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu fɚ ju hɪɹz ə pɛn/
dialogue.zh: 你兩張就好。這支筆給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy. Can I sit by the window?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi kæn aɪ sɪt baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不難。我可以坐在窗邊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔɹs teɪk jʊɹ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，慢慢填。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, um, do I wait here after?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʌm du aɪ weɪt hɪɹ ˈæftɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那個，填完就在這裡等嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost. First, let's check your blood pressure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌmoʊst fɜɹst lɛts tʃɛk jʊɹ blʌd ˈpɹɛʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 先別急，我們量一下血壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Here's my arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hɪɹz maɪ ɑɹm/
dialogue.zh: 好，手臂給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax. It's a little high today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈlæks ɪts ə ˈlɪtəl haɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 放鬆。今天有點偏高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: High? How high, if you don't mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ haʊ haɪ ɪf ju doʊnt maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 偏高？呃，高到多少呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hundred forty, over ninety.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhʌndɹəd ˈfɔɹti ˈoʊvɚ ˈnɪnti/
dialogue.zh: 一百四十，九十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My doctor's going to ask me that.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈdɑktɚz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə æsk mi ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 醫生一定會問這個的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note it. Did you take your pills today?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl noʊt ɪt dɪd ju teɪk jʊɹ pɪlz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我記錄下來。今天的藥吃了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not yet. I usually take them at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt aɪ ˈjuʒəwəli teɪk ðɛm æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還沒，我通常晚上才吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine. Bring the bottle next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts faɪn bɹɪŋ ðə ˈbɑtəl nɛkst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，下次記得把藥瓶帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Um, how long's the wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʌm haʊ lɔŋz ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。那個，我還要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The doctor is running ten minutes late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɑktɚ ɪz ˈɹʌnɪŋ tɛn ˈmɪnəts leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 醫生大約遲十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's okay. My morning's wide open.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts oʊˈkeɪ maɪ ˈmɔɹnɪŋz waɪd ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我上午沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's free coffee over there, if you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛɹz fri ˈkɔfi ˈoʊvɚ ðɛɹ ɪf ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 那邊有免費咖啡，想喝自己倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free coffee? Now that's care.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri ˈkɔfi naʊ ðæts kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 免費咖啡？真貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! A chair by the window helps too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ə tʃɛɹ baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ hɛlps tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！靠窗的位子也讓人放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, nurse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɔt əv ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ nɜɹs/
dialogue.zh: 護士小姐，你想得真周到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I've done this job ten years.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪv dʌn ðɪs dʒɑb tɛn jɪɹz/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這工作我做十年囉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten years? Time flies.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn jɪɹz taɪm flɑɪz/
dialogue.zh: 十年？時間過得真快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anyway, are these forms all filled out?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌwɛ ɑɹ ðiz fɔɹmz ɔl fɪld aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 對了，你的表格都填好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every box. Check my name, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi bɑks tʃɛk maɪ neɪm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 都勾好了，請檢查我的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Frank Miller, right? Just sign here.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹæŋk ˈmɪlɚ ɹaɪt dʒʌst saɪn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 法蘭克．米勒，對吧？這裡簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Signed. Did I spell my name right?
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd dɪd aɪ spɛl maɪ neɪm ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。我名字拼對了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did. Okay, they're ready for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd oʊˈkeɪ ðɛɹ ˈɹɛdi fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。好，醫生準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already? I didn't hear my name called.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈɛɹdi aɪ ˈdɪdənt hɪɹ maɪ neɪm kɔld/
dialogue.zh: 已經了嗎？我沒聽到叫號啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're room two. Right behind me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ rum tu ɹaɪt bɪˈhaɪnd mi/
dialogue.zh: 你在二號診室，跟著我走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room two. Can I bring my coffee?
dialogue.phonetic: /rum tu kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 二號診室。我可以帶咖啡進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A lidded cup is fine. Go ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪdəd kʌp ɪz faɪn ɡoʊ əˈhɛd/
dialogue.zh: 有蓋的就好，請進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Thank you, nurse...?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt θæŋk ju nɜɹs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。謝謝妳，護士小姐……？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's Dana. And do you have your log?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈdanə ænd du ju hæv jʊɹ lɔɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我叫丹娜。血壓筆記帶來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right here in my jacket pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt hɪɹ ɪn maɪ ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkət/
dialogue.zh: 就在我的外套口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. You're all set, Mr. Miller.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl jʊɹ ɔl sɛt ˈmɪstɚ ˈmɪlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，米勒先生，你準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frank is fine. See you around, Dana.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹæŋk ɪz faɪn si ju əˈɹaʊnd ˈdanə/
dialogue.zh: 叫我法蘭克就好。回頭見，丹娜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you! I'll tell the doctor you're in.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju aɪl tɛl ðə ˈdɑktɚ jʊɹ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 回頭見！我幫你去通知醫生。

script.youtube_description:
60句診所報到聽力練習：頭一次到診所，保險卡過期了怎麼辦？

這一集跟著一位新病人從櫃台報到開始，學會出示保險卡、填新病人表格、說明就醫原因、量血壓、問等候時間，還有用手機裡的老卡照片解決問題，最後跟著護士進診間。

你會聽到：
- 報到問句：「Do you have an appointment?」

- 量血壓說法：「It's a little high today.」
- 表格與簽名：「Just sign here.」

script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of doctor-visit check-in listening practice: a brand-new patient walks up to the clinic desk, and his insurance plan just expired. What now?

In this episode you will hear how to say you have an appointment, show your insurance card, describe why you came in, fill out new-patient forms, get your blood pressure checked, and ask about wait times — plus a clever phone-photo fix for an expired card.

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
